item.title: Passenger traffic at Mitchell International Airport dipped in 2025
item.description: Passenger traffic at Milwaukee Mitchell International Airport dipped 7% in 2025 to 5,874,372, down from 6,316,245 in 2024, according to the latest air traffic report from the airport. That was the lowest number of passengers served at the airport since 2022 when 5,439,055 passengers were served. The decline also ended four consecutive years of passengers […]

item.description: The Milwaukee LGBT Community Center is relocating to a new space at 161 S. 1st St., returning the organization to the city’s Walker’s Point neighborhood, where it first opened in 1998. item.title: WCTC plans Applied AI Lab expansion for this summer
item.description: Waukesha County Technical College plans to begin construction for the Applied AI Lab’s second-story addition in June.

item.title: Milwaukee convenience store owner charged in $1.6 million SNAP fraud scheme
item.description: Former Milwaukee convenience store owner Nael Jabbar is charged with wire fraud after allegedly running a $1.6 million SNAP benefits scheme.

item.description: Brookfield’s Café Manna, a vegetarian café located at 3815 N. Brookfield Road in Sendik’s Towne Centre, will close in March after 18 years in business.
